test_apply_temperature: test the policies._apply_temperature function to scale logits by a given temperature value
test_mask_invalid_actions: test the policies._mask_invalid_actions function to mask invalid actions by setting their logits to negative infinity
test_muzero_policy: test the mctx.muzero_policy function to run Monte Carlo tree search with a bandit recurrent function
test_gumbel_muzero_policy: test the mctx.gumbel_muzero_policy function with gumbel noise, max depth, and qtransform for action selection
test_stochastic_muzero_policy: test the mctx.stochastic_muzero_policy function with decision and chance recurrent functions for stochastic environments
